articles.title: COP31：用电更多，就一定更环保吗？
articles.titleEn: COP31 debates whether electrification is enough to tackle climate change
articles.en: At COP31 in Turkey, more than 30 countries backed a voluntary pledge to increase electricity's share of global energy consumption from roughly 20% to 35% by 2035. Yet the proposal does not require that electricity to come from renewable sources. Critics argue that electrification（电气化）could deliver limited climate benefits if fossil fuels（化石燃料）continue to dominate power generation.
articles.zh: 30 多个国家支持到 2035 年提高电力在能源消费中的占比，但没有要求这些电力必须是清洁能源。因此，“电气化”不一定等于“减碳”。
articles.whyItMatters: AI 数据中心和电动车都需要大量电力。讨论科技是否环保，不能只看产品，还要看电力从哪里来。
articles.question: Is switching to electric technology always beneficial for the environment?
articles.speakingHint: 先肯定电气化的潜力，再让步指出电力来源的重要性。用 COP31 的 35% 目标举例。
articles.expressions: It depends largely on...（这很大程度取决于……） · We shouldn't overlook the fact that...（我们不应忽视……）
articles.verification: 来自原聊天的学习摘要；本站迁移时未独立核验报道。

questions.question: What are some examples of electric technology in everyday life?
questions.zh: 日常生活中有哪些电气化技术？
directions: 还可举公共服务的例子：电动渡船可承担水上通勤，不限于道路车辆。
再举农业中的电动灌溉水泵，说明电气化不限于城市家庭。

expressions.en: Electric ferries are another example in public transport.
expressions.zh: 电动渡船是公共交通中的另一个例子。

expressions.en: In agriculture, electric pumps can be used for irrigation.
expressions.zh: 农业中可以用电动水泵进行灌溉。

answerAngles.title: 交通
answerAngles.zh: 举电动公交和自行车，直接说明用途。
answerAngles.en: Electric buses and electric bicycles are two everyday examples. They use electricity for transport instead of relying directly on fuel burned in a conventional engine.

answerAngles.title: 建筑与生活
answerAngles.zh: 举电热泵或电磁炉，补充取代何种过程。
answerAngles.en: Electric heat pumps and induction cookers are other examples in buildings. These technologies change how energy is used, but their overall environmental impact still depends on how the electricity is generated.

sampleAnswer.en: Electric buses and electric bicycles are two everyday examples. They use electricity for transport instead of relying directly on fuel burned in a conventional engine. Electric heat pumps and induction cookers are other examples in buildings. These technologies change how energy is used, but their overall environmental impact still depends on how the electricity is generated.
sampleAnswer.zh: 电动公交车和电动自行车是两个日常例子。它们利用电力出行，而不是直接依靠传统发动机燃烧燃料。建筑中的电热泵和电磁炉也是例子。这些技术改变了能源的使用方式，但它们整体的环境影响仍取决于电力的生产方式。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

questions.question: Why does the source of electricity matter for environmental outcomes?
questions.zh: 为什么电力来源会影响环保效果？
directions: 换一个角度：用电发生在什么时候也可能重要，电网不同时段的供电组合可能不同。
可建议在条件允许时调整充电时段，但不能保证某时段在所有地方都更清洁。

expressions.en: The timing of electricity use can matter as well.
expressions.zh: 用电时间也可能很重要。

expressions.en: This would depend on the local electricity supply.
expressions.zh: 这要取决于当地的电力供应。

answerAngles.title: 排放可能转移
answerAngles.zh: 用煤电充车假设说明车不冒烟不等于发电无排放。
answerAngles.en: If electricity is generated using fossil fuels, an electric device may still be linked to emissions at the power station. The pollution has not necessarily disappeared just because the device produces no exhaust itself.

answerAngles.title: 清洁来源提高潜力
answerAngles.zh: 风能太阳能等低排放来源，结合用电效率判断。
answerAngles.en: With lower-emission electricity sources, the same device may offer greater environmental benefits. So I would look at both the energy source and how efficiently the device is used.

sampleAnswer.en: If electricity is generated using fossil fuels, an electric device may still be linked to emissions at the power station. The pollution has not necessarily disappeared just because the device produces no exhaust itself. With lower-emission electricity sources, the same device may offer greater environmental benefits. So I would look at both the energy source and how efficiently the device is used.
sampleAnswer.zh: 如果电力来自化石燃料，电动设备仍可能与发电站的排放有关。设备自身不排尾气，并不意味着污染一定消失了。如果采用排放较低的电力来源，同一设备可能带来更大的环境效益。因此，我会同时考虑能源来源和设备的使用效率。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

questions.question: How could universities reduce the environmental impact of their technology use?
questions.zh: 大学可以如何减少使用科技的环境影响？
directions: 从软件与使用习惯展开：避免重复的大规模计算和不必要的数据储存。
提出学生能做的小行动：课程项目先估算计算需要，再选择合适的工具。

expressions.en: Students could avoid running the same large task unnecessarily.
expressions.zh: 学生可以避免不必要地重复运行同一个大型任务。

expressions.en: The tool should match the actual needs of the assignment.
expressions.zh: 工具应当符合任务的实际需要。

answerAngles.title: 减少浪费
answerAngles.zh: 举空教室关闭空调，预约控制设备时间，别只换设备。
answerAngles.en: Universities could reduce unnecessary energy use by switching off cooling and equipment in empty rooms. This could be a practical first step before buying expensive replacement technology.

answerAngles.title: 延长设备寿命
answerAngles.zh: 维修电脑、回收设备、采购时考虑能耗和可修性。
answerAngles.en: They could also repair computers where possible and include energy efficiency and repairability in purchasing decisions. Reducing waste involves how long equipment is used as well as how it is powered.

sampleAnswer.en: Universities could reduce unnecessary energy use by switching off cooling and equipment in empty rooms. This could be a practical first step before buying expensive replacement technology. They could also repair computers where possible and include energy efficiency and repairability in purchasing decisions. Reducing waste involves how long equipment is used as well as how it is powered.
sampleAnswer.zh: 大学可以在房间无人使用时关闭制冷和其他设备，减少不必要的能源消耗。在购买昂贵的替代技术之前，这可能是切实可行的第一步。大学也可以尽可能维修电脑，并在采购时考虑能效和可维修性。减少浪费不仅涉及设备如何供电，也涉及设备使用多久。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

questions.question: Is switching to electric technology always beneficial for the environment?
questions.zh: 改用电气化技术是否总是有利于环境？
directions: 补充反弹效应：如果使用成本降低后出行次数大增，部分效率收益可能被抵消。
讨论是否真的需要换新设备；尚能使用的设备过早报废也可能造成浪费。

expressions.en: Lower running costs may encourage people to use more energy overall.
expressions.zh: 更低的使用成本可能促使人们总体使用更多能源。

expressions.en: Replacing a working device too early can also create waste.
expressions.zh: 过早更换仍能工作的设备也会造成浪费。

answerAngles.title: 不总是：看电源与生产
answerAngles.zh: 直接说不总是，说明制造与发电都要考虑。
answerAngles.en: Not always. Electric technology can have environmental benefits, but its overall impact depends on electricity generation and manufacturing. An electric vehicle is not automatically a zero-impact product.

answerAngles.title: 条件性支持
answerAngles.zh: 结合清洁电力、合理用量、公共交通；不要承诺固定减排数字。
answerAngles.en: I would support electrification alongside cleaner power and efficient use. For example, improving public transport may be more useful than only encouraging everyone to buy a new electric car.

sampleAnswer.en: Not always. Electric technology can have environmental benefits, but its overall impact depends on electricity generation and manufacturing. An electric vehicle is not automatically a zero-impact product. I would support electrification alongside cleaner power and efficient use. For example, improving public transport may be more useful than only encouraging everyone to buy a new electric car.
sampleAnswer.zh: 不总是。电气化技术可能带来环境效益，但其整体影响取决于发电和制造过程。电动汽车并不是天然就对环境毫无影响的产品。我支持将电气化与更清洁的电力和高效使用相结合。例如，改善公共交通可能比仅仅鼓励所有人购买新的电动汽车更有用。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

articles.title: 美国进一步限制中国企业获取先进 AI 算力
articles.titleEn: New US chip restrictions put pressure on China's AI industry
articles.en: Chinese technology companies are assessing the consequences of tighter US restrictions on advanced AI chips, including access through overseas data centres. Alibaba reported a 53% year-on-year increase in AI cloud and computing revenue, even as restrictions threaten its expansion plans. The measures may accelerate China's push for technological self-reliance（技术自主）, but developing competitive domestic alternatives could take time.
articles.zh: 美国进一步限制中国企业通过海外数据中心使用先进芯片。阿里巴巴 AI 云及计算收入同比增长 53%，但未来扩张面临不确定性。
articles.whyItMatters: 这不仅是贸易问题，还涉及 AI 创新、供应链以及技术全球化。
articles.question: Should countries prioritise technological independence over international cooperation?
articles.speakingHint: 技术自主有助于降低供应风险，但国际合作也能提高创新效率。引用中国企业面临芯片限制的案例。
articles.expressions: reduce dependence on...（减少对……的依赖） · come at the expense of...（以牺牲……为代价）
articles.verification: 来自原聊天的学习摘要；本站迁移时未独立核验报道。

questions.question: What does technological self-reliance mean?
questions.zh: 技术自主是什么意思？
directions: 从维护能力定义自主：设备出现故障后能否自行诊断和维修。
从知识角度补充：是否掌握关键设计知识，而不只看零件产地。

expressions.en: Self-reliance can include the ability to maintain essential systems.
expressions.zh: 自主能力可以包括维护基本系统的能力。

expressions.en: Where a product is assembled does not tell the whole story.
expressions.zh: 产品在哪里组装，并不能说明全部情况。

answerAngles.title: 关键能力
answerAngles.zh: 定义是维持重要设备与服务，不等同所有零件自己造。
answerAngles.en: Technological self-reliance means having enough capability to maintain important technologies and services. It does not necessarily mean producing every component within one country.

answerAngles.title: 例子与平衡
answerAngles.zh: 举培养工程师、备用供应商，同时仍可合作研究。
answerAngles.en: For example, a country might train engineers and develop alternative suppliers while continuing to cooperate with overseas researchers. The key aim would be to reduce vulnerability rather than end all international connections.

sampleAnswer.en: Technological self-reliance means having enough capability to maintain important technologies and services. It does not necessarily mean producing every component within one country. For example, a country might train engineers and develop alternative suppliers while continuing to cooperate with overseas researchers. The key aim would be to reduce vulnerability rather than end all international connections.
sampleAnswer.zh: 技术自主意味着具备足够的能力来维持重要技术和服务。它不一定意味着在一个国家内部生产每一个零部件。例如，一个国家可以培养工程师、发展替代供应商，同时继续与海外研究人员合作。关键目标是降低脆弱性，而不是切断所有国际联系。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

questions.question: Why can dependence on a small number of suppliers create risks?
questions.zh: 依赖少量供应商为什么可能带来风险？
directions: 补充共同故障：供应商名字不同，也可能依赖同一上游工厂。
再说切换成本：设备标准和软件兼容性可能让替换比预想更慢。

expressions.en: Different suppliers may still share the same upstream producer.
expressions.zh: 不同供应商仍可能依赖同一上游生产商。

expressions.en: An alternative product may not be immediately compatible.
expressions.zh: 替代产品未必能立即兼容。

answerAngles.title: 供应中断
answerAngles.zh: 假设工厂停产或出口限制，学校小企业也可能拿不到设备。
answerAngles.en: If a country depends on only a few suppliers, a factory closure or a trade restriction could interrupt access to important equipment. Schools and small businesses might then face delays.

answerAngles.title: 缺少选择
answerAngles.zh: 替代少意味着成本与调整压力，分散也有成本。
answerAngles.en: Having few alternatives may also make it harder to negotiate prices or change products. However, maintaining several suppliers has costs, so resilience needs to be planned rather than assumed.

sampleAnswer.en: If a country depends on only a few suppliers, a factory closure or a trade restriction could interrupt access to important equipment. Schools and small businesses might then face delays. Having few alternatives may also make it harder to negotiate prices or change products. However, maintaining several suppliers has costs, so resilience needs to be planned rather than assumed.
sampleAnswer.zh: 如果一个国家只依赖少数供应商，工厂关闭或贸易限制就可能中断重要设备的供应。学校和小企业随后可能面临延误。替代选择少也可能让议价或更换产品更困难。不过，维持多个供应商需要成本，因此供应韧性需要规划，不能想当然地认为它自然存在。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

questions.question: How could countries make their technology supply chains more resilient?
questions.zh: 国家如何增强科技供应链的韧性？
directions: 从应急准备展开：为关键设备预留适量备件，并定期演练替代方案。
从标准展开：适当统一接口可减少被某个特定产品锁定的风险。

expressions.en: A tested backup plan can be as important as a new supplier.
expressions.zh: 经过测试的备用方案可能和新供应商同样重要。

expressions.en: Common technical standards could make switching easier.
expressions.zh: 共同的技术标准可以使切换更容易。

answerAngles.title: 多元供应
answerAngles.zh: 国家和企业可以寻找替代供应来源，避免单一点故障。
answerAngles.en: Countries could encourage firms to use a wider range of reliable suppliers. This would reduce the chance that a problem in one location interrupts the whole supply chain.

answerAngles.title: 人才与合作
answerAngles.zh: 培训本地工程师、投资研究，同时保持技术交流。
answerAngles.en: They could also invest in technical education and long-term research. Building domestic skills takes time, so this should be combined with cooperation rather than treated as an immediate replacement for imported technology.

sampleAnswer.en: Countries could encourage firms to use a wider range of reliable suppliers. This would reduce the chance that a problem in one location interrupts the whole supply chain. They could also invest in technical education and long-term research. Building domestic skills takes time, so this should be combined with cooperation rather than treated as an immediate replacement for imported technology.
sampleAnswer.zh: 各国可以鼓励企业使用更多可靠的供应商。这可以降低某个地区出现问题就中断整个供应链的可能性。各国也可以投资技术教育和长期研究。培养国内技能需要时间，因此应当将其与合作结合，而不是把它当成进口技术的即时替代品。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

questions.question: Should countries prioritise technological independence over international cooperation?
questions.zh: 国家是否应优先追求技术独立，而非国际合作？
directions: 补充小国视角：市场规模有限时，独自承担全部研发可能不划算。
可提出区域合作，让成员在不同领域形成专长并互相备份。

expressions.en: Smaller countries may benefit from sharing specialist capabilities.
expressions.zh: 较小的国家可能从共享专业能力中受益。

expressions.en: Independence in every area may be an unrealistic goal.
expressions.zh: 在每个领域都实现独立可能是不现实的目标。

answerAngles.title: 关键技术需保障
answerAngles.zh: 直接给平衡立场，重要基础设施不能毫无替代。
answerAngles.en: I think countries need some independence in critical technologies so that essential services are not completely vulnerable to supply disruptions. Developing local expertise can therefore be worthwhile.

answerAngles.title: 完全独立代价高
answerAngles.zh: 举成本与重复研发，主张多元供应+合作。
answerAngles.en: However, complete independence could be very expensive and limit the exchange of ideas. I would favour diversified suppliers, domestic skills and continued research cooperation instead of trying to produce everything alone.

sampleAnswer.en: I think countries need some independence in critical technologies so that essential services are not completely vulnerable to supply disruptions. Developing local expertise can therefore be worthwhile. However, complete independence could be very expensive and limit the exchange of ideas. I would favour diversified suppliers, domestic skills and continued research cooperation instead of trying to produce everything alone.
sampleAnswer.zh: 我认为，各国在关键技术方面需要一定的自主性，以免基本服务完全受制于供应中断。因此，发展本土专业能力可能是值得的。不过，完全独立可能成本极高，并限制思想交流。我更支持供应商多元化、培养国内技能以及继续开展科研合作，而不是试图独自生产所有东西。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

articles.title: 中美俄三方会晤：对话是否等于进展？
articles.titleEn: US, China and Russia hold high-level talks without a major breakthrough
articles.en: The leaders of China, the United States and Russia held a roughly 90-minute meeting during the APEC summit in Shenzhen. Their discussions addressed nuclear risks and international security, but produced no concrete breakthrough（实质性突破）on major conflicts. The meeting illustrates how diplomatic engagement（外交接触）can keep communication channels open without necessarily resolving disagreements.
articles.zh: 三方领导人在深圳 APEC 会议期间进行了约 90 分钟的会晤，讨论核风险与国际安全，但没有在重大冲突问题上取得明确突破。
articles.whyItMatters: 外交成功不一定意味着马上达成协议。有时防止误判本身就有价值。
articles.question: Can diplomatic meetings be considered successful even without an agreement?
articles.speakingHint: 区分短期成果和长期价值。会谈可能缺少实质进展，但有助于维持沟通。
articles.expressions: keep communication channels open（保持沟通渠道） · lay the groundwork for...（为……奠定基础）
articles.verification: 来自原聊天的学习摘要；本站迁移时未独立核验报道。

questions.question: What are some purposes of diplomatic meetings?
questions.zh: 外交会谈有哪些目的？
directions: 还可以说领事事务：会谈可处理旅客、在外公民和人员往来问题。
再说技术层面的合作：即使政治立场不同，也能商谈具体操作安排。

expressions.en: Some meetings focus on practical arrangements for citizens abroad.
expressions.zh: 有些会谈着重处理与海外公民有关的实际安排。

expressions.en: A narrow technical discussion can still have practical value.
expressions.zh: 范围有限的技术讨论仍可以有实际价值。

answerAngles.title: 交换信息
answerAngles.zh: 说清想法与限制，减少把对方行为误判为敌意。
answerAngles.en: One purpose is to clarify each side's intentions and concerns. When governments understand what others are trying to do, they may be less likely to misinterpret an action.

answerAngles.title: 建立沟通渠道
answerAngles.zh: 即使没协议，也能商定下次联系、紧急联系人。
answerAngles.en: Another purpose is to create channels for future communication. A meeting might establish who should be contacted during a crisis, even if it does not produce a major agreement.

sampleAnswer.en: One purpose is to clarify each side's intentions and concerns. When governments understand what others are trying to do, they may be less likely to misinterpret an action. Another purpose is to create channels for future communication. A meeting might establish who should be contacted during a crisis, even if it does not produce a major agreement.
sampleAnswer.zh: 一个目的是澄清各方的意图和关切。当政府了解其他国家想做什么时，就可能更不容易误解某项行动。另一个目的是为未来的交流建立渠道。即使会议没有达成重大协议，也可能确定在危机期间应该联系谁。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

questions.question: Why can communication be useful even without immediate agreement?
questions.zh: 即使无法立刻达成协议，沟通为什么仍有价值？
directions: 从公众预期展开：解释谈判的限制，可能减少不切实际的要求。
从信息准确性展开：直接交流可减少只依赖媒体转述带来的误差。

expressions.en: Direct contact may reduce reliance on incomplete second-hand information.
expressions.zh: 直接联系可能减少对不完整的二手信息的依赖。

expressions.en: It can also make the limits of negotiation clearer.
expressions.zh: 这也可以使谈判的局限更加清楚。

answerAngles.title: 纠正误解
answerAngles.zh: 各方解释底线与担忧，降低基于错误假设行动的风险。
answerAngles.en: Communication can reveal misunderstandings before they lead to worse decisions. One side may discover that an action it saw as threatening had a different purpose.

answerAngles.title: 为后续铺路
answerAngles.zh: 用小组分工争议作假设类比，指出国家争端复杂得多。
answerAngles.en: In a simple group-project analogy, students might first explain their concerns before agreeing on a plan. International disputes are much more complex, but clarification can still be a useful first step.

sampleAnswer.en: Communication can reveal misunderstandings before they lead to worse decisions. One side may discover that an action it saw as threatening had a different purpose. In a simple group-project analogy, students might first explain their concerns before agreeing on a plan. International disputes are much more complex, but clarification can still be a useful first step.
sampleAnswer.zh: 沟通可以在误解导致更糟的决策之前揭示这些误解。一方可能发现，自己认为具有威胁性的行动其实另有目的。用一个简单的小组作业类比来说，学生可能先解释各自的担忧，再就计划达成一致。国际争端复杂得多，但澄清问题仍可能是有用的第一步。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

questions.question: How could parties build trust when they have conflicting interests?
questions.zh: 利益冲突的各方可以怎样建立信任？
directions: 补充独立核查：如果彼此不信任，可让双方接受的第三方核实小范围承诺。
讨论保密与公开的平衡：谈判细节不必全部直播，但最终承诺应清晰。

expressions.en: An agreed third party could help verify limited commitments.
expressions.zh: 双方认可的第三方可以帮助核实有限范围的承诺。

expressions.en: Trust also requires a shared way of checking progress.
expressions.zh: 信任还需要共同核查进展的方式。

answerAngles.title: 从小承诺开始
answerAngles.zh: 举共享信息、按时回复、落实小范围合作。
answerAngles.en: Parties could begin with small, realistic commitments, such as sharing agreed information or responding within a set period. Keeping those promises may be more convincing than making a dramatic public statement.

answerAngles.title: 记录并复查
answerAngles.zh: 会议后明确下一步和时间，避免只有合照。
answerAngles.en: They could also record what was agreed and arrange a follow-up meeting. Trust is more likely to grow if words are followed by observable actions.

sampleAnswer.en: Parties could begin with small, realistic commitments, such as sharing agreed information or responding within a set period. Keeping those promises may be more convincing than making a dramatic public statement. They could also record what was agreed and arrange a follow-up meeting. Trust is more likely to grow if words are followed by observable actions.
sampleAnswer.zh: 各方可以从小而切实可行的承诺开始，例如分享商定的信息，或在规定期限内答复。履行这些承诺可能比发表引人注目的公开声明更有说服力。各方也可以记录达成的共识，并安排后续会议。如果言语之后有可观察到的行动，信任就更有可能增长。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

questions.question: Can diplomatic meetings be considered successful even without an agreement?
questions.zh: 没有达成协议的外交会议也能算成功吗？
directions: 换一个判断标准：如果会谈只是争取时间、同时局势继续恶化，就不能只强调沟通价值。
可以设后续时间点，看是否减少风险，而不只数举办了几场会议。

expressions.en: A meeting could be unproductive if it merely delays necessary action.
expressions.zh: 如果会议只是拖延必要行动，就可能没有成效。

expressions.en: I would assess what changes after the discussion.
expressions.zh: 我会评估讨论之后发生了什么变化。

answerAngles.title: 有条件算成功
answerAngles.zh: 成功有不同层次：降低误判、保留沟通都可算有限成果。
answerAngles.en: Yes, a meeting can have limited success even without an agreement. Clarifying concerns or establishing an emergency contact may reduce the risk of misunderstandings.

answerAngles.title: 不能只看见面
answerAngles.zh: 长期无落实则不够，需要后续目标。
answerAngles.en: However, a meeting should not be praised simply because it happened. I would look for follow-up actions and realistic goals, while accepting that some disagreements cannot be resolved in one conversation.

sampleAnswer.en: Yes, a meeting can have limited success even without an agreement. Clarifying concerns or establishing an emergency contact may reduce the risk of misunderstandings. However, a meeting should not be praised simply because it happened. I would look for follow-up actions and realistic goals, while accepting that some disagreements cannot be resolved in one conversation.
sampleAnswer.zh: 可以，即使没有达成协议，会议也可能取得有限的成功。澄清关切或建立紧急联系渠道，可能降低误解的风险。不过，不能仅仅因为会议举行了就称赞它。我会看后续行动和现实可行的目标，同时也接受有些分歧无法在一次对话中解决。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

articles.title: AI 投资太快，也可能推高通胀？
articles.titleEn: Federal Reserve official warns that the AI boom could fuel inflation
articles.en: Chicago Federal Reserve President Austan Goolsbee warned that surging investment in AI infrastructure could strain the economy's productive capacity（生产能力）. Although AI may improve productivity in the long run, unusually rapid spending on data centres and equipment could create inflationary pressure（通胀压力）in the short term.
articles.zh: AI 长期可能提高生产率，但如果企业短时间内集中投资数据中心、设备和基础设施，经济供给能力可能跟不上需求，推动价格上涨。
articles.whyItMatters: 技术进步不一定立刻带来经济好处；短期成本与长期收益可能不同。这是美联储官员的风险判断，而非通胀已经发生的证据。
articles.question: Does rapid technological investment always benefit the economy?
articles.speakingHint: 用 short-term versus long-term 结构：短期可能增加成本，长期可能提高效率。
articles.expressions: in the long run（从长远来看） · put pressure on...（给……带来压力）
articles.verification: 来自原聊天的学习摘要；本站迁移时未独立核验报道。

questions.question: What resources are needed to build new digital infrastructure?
questions.zh: 建设数字基础设施需要哪些资源？
directions: 从资源约束的另一面举例：建设还需要规划许可和通信网络接入。
说明资源不全是材料：协调不同机构也需要时间。

expressions.en: Planning approval and network connections are also necessary.
expressions.zh: 规划许可和网络连接也是必需的。

expressions.en: Coordination takes time even when funding is available.
expressions.zh: 即使资金到位，协调仍需要时间。

answerAngles.title: 物理基础设施
answerAngles.zh: 举数据中心需要电、土地、冷却系统和设备，AI不是只需要代码。
answerAngles.en: Digital infrastructure requires physical resources such as electricity, land, cooling systems and computer equipment. A data centre is not simply a piece of software that can be expanded without limits.

answerAngles.title: 人和公共配套
answerAngles.zh: 还需工程师、工人及稳定供电交通配套。
answerAngles.en: It also needs skilled engineers and construction workers. Local power networks and other services may need to expand as well, so the costs go beyond buying computers.

sampleAnswer.en: Digital infrastructure requires physical resources such as electricity, land, cooling systems and computer equipment. A data centre is not simply a piece of software that can be expanded without limits. It also needs skilled engineers and construction workers. Local power networks and other services may need to expand as well, so the costs go beyond buying computers.
sampleAnswer.zh: 数字基础设施需要电力、土地、冷却系统和计算机设备等实体资源。数据中心并不只是一段可以无限扩展的软件。它还需要熟练的工程师和建筑工人。当地电网和其他服务也可能需要扩建，因此成本不止是购买电脑。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

questions.question: Why might rapid spending create short-term pressures?
questions.zh: 快速增加支出为什么可能带来短期压力？
directions: 补充融资角度：项目先借钱投入，但未来收入可能晚于预期。
说明不确定性：不是所有短期成本压力都会变成持续通胀。

expressions.en: Revenue may arrive later than the initial costs.
expressions.zh: 收入可能晚于初始成本出现。

expressions.en: Temporary pressure does not automatically imply lasting inflation.
expressions.zh: 短期压力并不自动意味着持续通胀。

answerAngles.title: 需求快于供给
answerAngles.zh: 假设许多项目同时抢电工设备，供给短期跟不上。
answerAngles.en: Rapid spending can create pressure when many projects need the same workers and equipment at once. Those resources may not become available as quickly as demand increases.

answerAngles.title: 成本传递不均
answerAngles.zh: 建设地点供电或住房承压，长期收益未必马上出现。
answerAngles.en: Local services and housing may also come under pressure during construction. A project could bring longer-term benefits while still creating short-term difficulties for nearby communities.

sampleAnswer.en: Rapid spending can create pressure when many projects need the same workers and equipment at once. Those resources may not become available as quickly as demand increases. Local services and housing may also come under pressure during construction. A project could bring longer-term benefits while still creating short-term difficulties for nearby communities.
sampleAnswer.zh: 当许多项目同时需要相同的工人和设备时，快速增加支出就可能造成压力。这些资源的供给速度可能赶不上需求增长。建设期间，当地服务和住房也可能承压。一个项目可能带来长期效益，同时仍给附近社区造成短期困难。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

questions.question: How could governments support innovation while managing its costs?
questions.zh: 政府如何支持创新并管理其成本？
directions: 从竞争角度展开：支持不同规模的企业参与，避免补贴只流向少数大公司。
从公共监督展开：公开受益对象和退出条件，避免长期补贴无效项目。

expressions.en: Public support should be open to credible smaller firms too.
expressions.zh: 公共支持也应向可信的小型企业开放。

expressions.en: A subsidy should have clear review and exit conditions.
expressions.zh: 补贴应有清楚的审查和退出条件。

answerAngles.title: 分阶段建设
answerAngles.zh: 先测试需求，再扩建，给公共设施留准备时间。
answerAngles.en: Governments could support projects in stages so that infrastructure has time to catch up. Before expanding a programme, they could review whether there is real demand and whether local services can cope.

answerAngles.title: 培训和透明
answerAngles.zh: 培养相关技术人才，公布成本与目标，承认公共资金有限。
answerAngles.en: They could also fund relevant skills training and publish clear spending priorities. This may support innovation while making it easier to question projects whose costs are becoming unrealistic.

sampleAnswer.en: Governments could support projects in stages so that infrastructure has time to catch up. Before expanding a programme, they could review whether there is real demand and whether local services can cope. They could also fund relevant skills training and publish clear spending priorities. This may support innovation while making it easier to question projects whose costs are becoming unrealistic.
sampleAnswer.zh: 政府可以分阶段支持项目，让基础设施有时间跟上。在扩大项目之前，可以审查是否存在真实需求，以及当地服务能否承受。政府也可以资助相关技能培训，并公布清楚的支出优先事项。这可能既支持创新，也使人们更容易质疑成本变得不切实际的项目。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

questions.question: Does rapid technological investment always benefit the economy?
questions.zh: 快速的科技投资是否总有利于经济？
directions: 换到就业角度：短期建设岗位可能很多，但建成后岗位数量可能不同。
讨论地区公平：承担施工干扰的社区是否也获得培训和就业机会。

expressions.en: Construction jobs may differ from the jobs available after completion.
expressions.zh: 建设期间的岗位可能不同于建成后的岗位。

expressions.en: Local residents should have a fair chance to access new opportunities.
expressions.zh: 当地居民应有公平获得新机会的渠道。

answerAngles.title: 不总是立即获益
answerAngles.zh: 技术需先花钱建设施培训，收益需时间。
answerAngles.en: No, rapid technological investment does not always bring immediate benefits. Equipment must be installed and workers trained before a new system can improve how a business operates.

answerAngles.title: 不同人受益不同
answerAngles.zh: 技术公司获益而当地有成本，主张配套和评估。
answerAngles.en: The benefits may also be uneven: a technology company could gain while a community faces higher demand for electricity. I would assess investment over time and consider who receives the benefits and bears the costs.

sampleAnswer.en: No, rapid technological investment does not always bring immediate benefits. Equipment must be installed and workers trained before a new system can improve how a business operates. The benefits may also be uneven: a technology company could gain while a community faces higher demand for electricity. I would assess investment over time and consider who receives the benefits and bears the costs.
sampleAnswer.zh: 不是，快速的技术投资并不总能带来即时收益。在新系统改善企业运作方式之前，必须先安装设备并培训员工。收益也可能分配不均：科技公司可能获益，而社区却面对更高的用电需求。我会随时间评估投资，并考虑谁获得收益、谁承担成本。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

articles.title: 厄尔尼诺风险加剧，穷国气候适应资金不足
articles.titleEn: El Niño intensifies climate risks as adaptation funding falls short
articles.en: As COP31 negotiations continue, a powerful El Niño is raising concerns about droughts, floods and food insecurity（粮食不安全）across vulnerable regions. Developing countries are estimated to need around $300 billion annually for climate adaptation（气候适应）, yet received only $36 billion in 2024. The widening funding gap highlights an unequal distribution of climate risks and resources.
articles.zh: 发展中国家每年约需 3000 亿美元应对气候影响，但 2024 年实际获得的资金只有 360 亿美元。厄尔尼诺带来的旱涝风险使问题更紧迫。
articles.whyItMatters: 受到气候灾害影响最严重的地区，未必拥有足够资金保护农业、基础设施和居民。
articles.question: Should wealthier countries contribute more to climate adaptation?
articles.speakingHint: 支持者强调历史排放责任和支付能力；另一种观点强调资金使用透明度与各国共同责任。
articles.expressions: bear a disproportionate burden（承担不成比例的负担） · bridge the funding gap（弥合资金缺口）
articles.verification: 来自原聊天的学习摘要；本站迁移时未独立核验报道。

questions.question: What are some ways communities can respond to environmental risks?
questions.zh: 社区可以如何应对环境风险？
directions: 从互助网络举例：社区可建立高温期间探访独居居民的机制。
从家庭准备举例：提供清楚的撤离路线和应急物品清单。

expressions.en: Neighbourhood volunteers could check on isolated residents.
expressions.zh: 社区志愿者可以探访与外界联系较少的居民。

expressions.en: Clear evacuation routes can make preparation more practical.
expressions.zh: 清楚的撤离路线可以让准备工作更切实可行。

answerAngles.title: 预警
answerAngles.zh: 举高温提醒、洪水短信、避暑空间，是适应风险。
answerAngles.en: Communities could use early-warning systems, such as heat alerts or flood messages, to give people time to respond. Public cooling spaces could help people who cannot keep their homes safe during extreme heat.

answerAngles.title: 长期基础设施
answerAngles.zh: 维护排水和住房，区别灾后临时援助。
answerAngles.en: They could also improve drainage and housing over time. Emergency aid helps after a disaster, but better infrastructure may reduce the damage before the next event occurs.

sampleAnswer.en: Communities could use early-warning systems, such as heat alerts or flood messages, to give people time to respond. Public cooling spaces could help people who cannot keep their homes safe during extreme heat. They could also improve drainage and housing over time. Emergency aid helps after a disaster, but better infrastructure may reduce the damage before the next event occurs.
sampleAnswer.zh: 社区可以利用高温警报或洪水短信等预警系统，让人们有时间应对。公共避暑空间可以帮助那些在极端高温期间无法确保家中安全的人。社区也可以逐步改善排水和住房。紧急援助是在灾后提供帮助，而更好的基础设施可能在下一次灾害发生前就减少损失。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

questions.question: Why can environmental problems affect some groups more than others?
questions.zh: 环境问题为什么会对不同群体造成不同影响？
directions: 从信息差距展开：警报若只有一种语言，部分移民可能看不懂。
从身体条件展开：行动不便的人可能需要额外撤离协助。

expressions.en: A warning is less effective if people cannot understand its language.
expressions.zh: 如果人们看不懂预警所用的语言，其效果就会减弱。

expressions.en: People with limited mobility may need additional support.
expressions.zh: 行动受限的人可能需要额外支持。

answerAngles.title: 暴露程度
answerAngles.zh: 举户外工人更直接受热，低洼住宅易受洪水影响。
answerAngles.en: Some people are more exposed because of where they live or work. Outdoor workers, for example, may find it harder to avoid extreme heat than people working in cooled offices.

answerAngles.title: 应对资源
answerAngles.zh: 同样灾害富裕家庭有搬迁维修选择，低收入者缺少。
answerAngles.en: People also have different resources for responding. A family with savings may repair its home or move temporarily, while another family may have no affordable alternative.

sampleAnswer.en: Some people are more exposed because of where they live or work. Outdoor workers, for example, may find it harder to avoid extreme heat than people working in cooled offices. People also have different resources for responding. A family with savings may repair its home or move temporarily, while another family may have no affordable alternative.
sampleAnswer.zh: 有些人由于居住或工作的地点而面临更大风险。例如，与在有制冷设备的办公室工作的人相比，户外工作者可能更难避开极端高温。人们应对问题的资源也不同。有积蓄的家庭可能修缮住房或暂时搬走，而另一个家庭可能没有负担得起的替代选择。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

questions.question: How could limited funding be used more effectively to protect communities?
questions.zh: 怎样更有效地使用有限资金保护社区？
directions: 从跨部门配合展开：卫生、学校和交通系统可共用清楚的应急流程。
从透明取舍展开：解释为什么优先保护某些区域，邀请居民反馈。

expressions.en: Shared procedures could prevent agencies from working at cross purposes.
expressions.zh: 共同的流程可以避免不同机构的工作相互冲突。

expressions.en: Residents should understand why some projects are prioritised.
expressions.zh: 居民应当理解为什么某些项目被优先安排。

answerAngles.title: 找最紧迫问题
answerAngles.zh: 先和居民识别哪里风险最大，再优先低成本措施。
answerAngles.en: I would begin by identifying the most exposed groups and asking residents what they need. Limited funding could first support practical measures such as warnings, drinking-water access and safe shelters.

answerAngles.title: 维护和跟踪
answerAngles.zh: 预算留维护，检查是否真正覆盖老人等弱势群体。
answerAngles.en: Some money should be reserved for maintenance and evaluation. A new warning system is not useful if it stops working or fails to reach older residents and people without reliable internet access.

sampleAnswer.en: I would begin by identifying the most exposed groups and asking residents what they need. Limited funding could first support practical measures such as warnings, drinking-water access and safe shelters. Some money should be reserved for maintenance and evaluation. A new warning system is not useful if it stops working or fails to reach older residents and people without reliable internet access.
sampleAnswer.zh: 我会先识别风险暴露最大的人群，并询问居民的需要。有限资金可以优先支持预警、饮水获取和安全庇护所等实用措施。还应当留出一部分资金用于维护和评估。如果新的预警系统停止运作，或无法覆盖老年居民及网络不稳定的人，它就没有用。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

questions.question: Should wealthier countries contribute more to climate adaptation?
questions.zh: 较富裕的国家是否应为气候适应投入更多？
directions: 补充历史责任角度：可讨论过去的排放贡献，但不要编造国家排名或比例。
补充援助形式：技术共享、培训和优惠融资也可能有帮助，不只有捐款。

expressions.en: The discussion can include both capacity and historical responsibility.
expressions.zh: 讨论可以同时包括承担能力和历史责任。

expressions.en: Support can involve expertise as well as direct funding.
expressions.zh: 支持既可以包括直接资金，也可以包括专业知识。

answerAngles.title: 应多承担：能力
answerAngles.zh: 较富裕国家可负担技术和资金支持，更能承担大项目。
answerAngles.en: Yes, wealthier countries should contribute more because they generally have greater financial and technical capacity. They may be better able to fund infrastructure that poorer communities cannot afford on their own.

answerAngles.title: 配合本地决策
answerAngles.zh: 资金非唯一，听当地需要并透明追踪，避免强加方案。
answerAngles.en: However, funding should respond to local priorities and be monitored transparently. Sending money is not enough if projects are unsuitable or communities cannot maintain them afterwards.

sampleAnswer.en: Yes, wealthier countries should contribute more because they generally have greater financial and technical capacity. They may be better able to fund infrastructure that poorer communities cannot afford on their own. However, funding should respond to local priorities and be monitored transparently. Sending money is not enough if projects are unsuitable or communities cannot maintain them afterwards.
sampleAnswer.zh: 应该，较富裕的国家应作出更多贡献，因为它们通常有更强的资金和技术能力。它们可能更有能力资助较贫困社区无法独自负担的基础设施。不过，资金应回应当地优先需求，并接受透明监督。如果项目不适合当地，或者社区之后无法维护，仅仅送钱是不够的。

questions.additionalAngleLabel: 换一个角度，还可以这样说

speaking.text:
主题：Technology and the Environment (推荐练习 · 1–2 分钟)

今天选择第 1 条 COP31 新闻，因为它非常适合练习 balanced argument（平衡论证）。

Do you think technological progress is always good for the environment?

你认为技术进步总是对环境有利吗？

用这四步组织自己的回答：

1. 观点：Not necessarily. I think it depends on how technology is used.
2. 具体例子：At COP31, countries supported expanding electrification, but clean energy was not mandatory.
3. 解释影响：If electricity is generated from fossil fuels, some environmental benefits may be undermined.
4. 总结：So technological progress needs to go hand in hand with responsible energy policies.

---

Part 2 Follow-up

What can university students do to make technology more sustainable?

回答要点：避免不必要的电子设备更新、延长设备寿命、支持节能措施，同时承认个人行动无法替代政府和企业的系统性改变。

[一个加分思路]
